name: Bones, joints and muscles
definition: Messages about pain, injury, or conditions of the bones, joints, muscles, back, or neck. Includes arthritis, osteoporosis and fracture risk, joint injuries, and back, neck, knee, foot, or hand pain; excludes headaches and nerve pain (see Headaches and nerve pain) and chest or abdominal pain.

name: Stomach and digestion
definition: Messages about the stomach, bowel, and digestive tract, including belly pain and anal conditions. Includes stomach aches, gastritis, abdominal pain, and fistula or other anorectal problems; excludes general infectious illness such as colds or flu, and diet or nutrition goals.

name: Skin, hair and allergies
definition: Messages about the skin, scalp, or hair, or about allergic reactions. Includes eczema, hives, flaking scalp, hair growth, and allergies to medicines or other triggers; excludes infections whose main subject is general illness.

name: Infections and acute illness
definition: Messages about infections or sudden short-term illness such as colds, flu, or viral diseases. Includes fever, chills, body aches, named infectious diseases, abscesses, and questions about whether something is an infection; excludes long-lasting conditions of one organ system.

name: Diet, weight and fitness
definition: Messages about body weight, nutrition, exercise, or fitness goals. Includes healthy eating, protein and supplements for fitness, fat loss, normal weight, workouts, and weight-loss medicines such as GLP-1 drugs; excludes diabetes and hormone disorders.

name: Diabetes and hormones
definition: Messages about diabetes, blood sugar, or hormone and metabolic conditions. Includes A1c, diabetes, hormone imbalance, endocrinologists, PCOS, testosterone, and cholesterol; excludes weight and fitness goals that do not centre on a hormone or metabolic condition.

name: Eyes and vision
definition: Messages about the eyes and vision. Includes double vision, glasses, retina appointments, and cataract surgery; excludes eye pain that is only one symptom of a headache or other illness.

name: Sleep and fatigue
definition: Messages about sleep problems or tiredness. Includes poor or unrefreshing sleep, night waking, sleep apnea, fatigue, and sleep loss; excludes tiredness that is only one symptom of an acute illness such as flu.

name: Headaches and nerve pain
definition: Messages about headaches or nerve pain. Includes headaches with or without other symptoms and neuropathy; excludes pain in joints, muscles, back, or neck.

name: Pregnancy and reproductive health
definition: Messages about pregnancy, labor, menstruation, or the female reproductive organs. Includes labor and induction, endometriosis, periods, PCOS, and PMDD; excludes hormone questions not tied to reproduction.

name: Bones, joints and muscles
definition: Pain, injury, or conditions of the bones, joints, muscles, back, or neck. Includes joint pain, back and neck pain, osteoarthritis, osteoporosis and fractures, and bony lumps; excludes pain clearly from nerves (neuropathy) or from internal organs such as the stomach.

name: Stomach and digestion
definition: Problems of the stomach, belly, bowel, or anus. Includes stomach aches, abdominal pain, gastritis, and anal or perianal problems such as abscesses or fistulas; excludes weight and nutrition goals, which belong to diet.

name: Diet, weight and fitness
definition: Nutrition, body weight, exercise, supplements for fitness, and weight-loss medicines. Includes meal planning, protein, ideal weight, fat loss, workouts, and GLP-1 drugs such as Zepbound; excludes supplements taken to treat a named disease, which go under that disease's topic.

name: Eyes and vision
definition: Eye health and eyesight. Includes double vision, glasses, cataract surgery, and visits to eye doctors or retina specialists; excludes eye pain that is part of a headache.

name: Skin and allergies
definition: Skin, scalp, and hair problems and allergic reactions. Includes eczema, hives, flaking scalp, hair regrowth, and allergies to foods or medicines such as antibiotics; excludes infections that are not mainly a skin or allergy question.

name: Infections and acute illness
definition: Infections and sudden short-term illnesses. Includes flu-like symptoms, viral illnesses such as hand foot and mouth disease, and questions about infections in general; excludes long-term conditions and infections that are mainly about one body part already covered by another topic.

name: Hormones, diabetes and reproductive health
definition: Hormone, blood-sugar, and reproductive conditions. Includes diabetes and A1c, hormone imbalance, PCOS, endometriosis, periods, pregnancy and labor; excludes general weight or diet goals.

name: Mental health and sleep
definition: Emotional health, stress, behavior, and sleep. Includes anxiety, stress, family relationship struggles, sleep problems, sleep apnea, tiredness, and medicines given for behavior that affect sleep; excludes physical pain that wakes someone at night.

name: Headaches and nerve pain
definition: Headaches and nerve-related pain. Includes headaches with or without vomiting and neuropathy pain; excludes joint, muscle, or back pain.

name: Bones, joints and muscles
definition: Pain, injury, or conditions of the bones, joints, muscles, spine, or limbs. Includes back, neck, knee, foot and elbow pain, arthritis, bone density/osteoporosis, bony lumps, and nerve pain felt in a limb; excludes chest pain and abdominal pain.

name: Skin, hair and allergies
definition: Conditions of the skin, scalp, or hair, and allergic reactions. Includes flaking scalp, eczema, hives, hair regrowth, and allergies to foods or drugs; excludes abscesses or infections deeper under the skin, which go to infections or the affected organ.

name: Digestive and abdominal organs
definition: Problems of the stomach, bowel, anus, and other abdominal organs such as the kidneys and liver. Includes stomach aches, gastritis, belly pain, anal fistulas or perianal abscesses, and abdominal imaging results; excludes weight and diet goals.

name: Infections and acute illness
definition: Infectious diseases and sudden, short-term illness with general symptoms. Includes flu-like symptoms, fever and chills, viral illnesses such as hand foot and mouth, infections, and acute headache or vomiting; excludes chronic pain in a specific joint or organ.

name: Nutrition, weight and fitness
definition: Diet, body weight, and physical fitness. Includes healthy eating, protein and supplements for fitness, normal weight, weight-loss medicines such as GLP-1 drugs, and exercise; excludes diabetes and hormone disorders.

name: Hormones and metabolic conditions
definition: Hormone and metabolic disorders such as diabetes, blood sugar, cholesterol, testosterone, or general hormone imbalance. Includes A1c results, endocrinologist questions, and PCOS as a hormonal condition; excludes general diet or weight goals.

name: Eyes and vision
definition: The eyes and vision. Includes cataracts, retina specialist visits, double vision and glasses; excludes pain behind the eyes that is part of a headache or general illness.

name: Sleep and fatigue
definition: Sleep problems, sleep quality, and tiredness. Includes sleep apnea, waking at night, unrefreshing sleep, ongoing fatigue and sleep loss; excludes tiredness that is part of a sudden flu-like illness.

name: Women's reproductive health
definition: Female reproductive health, including pregnancy and labor, menstruation, endometriosis, PCOS, and PMDD. Excludes general hormone tests not tied to the reproductive system.
